debit.sms: Send BLOCK to +919222655555 from the registered mobile no. If multiple ATM/Debit cards in the same account: Send BLOCK <Account No> to +919222655555, then Send BLOCK <Account No> <Last 4 Digits of your ATM/Debit Card> to +919222655555.
debit.notes: Toll-free 1800 120 1600 is the bank's 24*7 Customer Care / dedicated CSFB helpline; only this toll-free is published for blocking (no chargeable or overseas line). SMS 'BLOCK' to +919222655555 blocks the ATM/Debit card permanently - reissue via parent branch (subject to re-issuance charges). NetBanking: Customer Services > Service Requests > Bank Accounts > More > 'Block Debit / ATM Card' under 'ATM/ Debit Card Related' > select card, reason, Submit. The bank's fraud PDF also lists blocking via Capital Mobile+ app or Internet Banking > Debit Card Management > Card Status > disallow the transaction limit via ATM, E-Com, POS, and Contactless. Bank's own pages direct online-fraud victims to the national cybercrime helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: The bank's report-an-unauthorized-transaction page publishes a NetBanking credit-card block path: Customer Services > Service Requests > Credit Card > More > choose 'Block Credit Card' under 'Credit Card Dispatch Related' > select card > Submit; the same page gives the dedicated CSFB helpline 1800 120 1600 and directs online-fraud victims to 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in. Caveat: the site's CARDS menu lists only debit-card products (no consumer credit-card product page), and no credit-card-specific SMS, email or app menu is published.
